lines.ruling: Ruling: equivalent; project retained. i1040gi pp. 106-107 (Schedule 1-A, Part III, methods 1 to 4) and Notice 2025-69 section III.B.2, methods (A) to (D), give the employer-reported or premium amount as is and the one-third, one-half and one-quarter conversions. Both give zero when otjob.flsa is false, the statement amount for employer_reported and premium, the statement times s1a.ot_third for total_time_and_half, s1a.ot_half for premium_double and s1a.ot_quarter for total_double, and zero for other (refused by otjob.refused before the line is used). The second tests otjob.flsa inside each method guard instead of first; the guards cover the same cases with the same values. This round changed only the wording of otjob.method and otjob.statement (hours over 40 in a workweek), not an expression.
